description: Idempotency + replay semantics. The service boundary rides the SAME authoritative Chat 1 idempotency foundation (idempotencyRecords) — it never re-implements it. The idempotency key is signed; the same key with the same request replays, the same key with a different request conflicts.

semantics.replay: Same idempotency key + same request fields returns the stored outcome reference (replayed=true) with no re-execution.
semantics.conflict: Same idempotency key + different request fields fails closed with IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (HTTP 409).
semantics.nonce: The nonce is consumed at most once per service identity; a reused nonce fails closed with REPLAY_DENIED.
semantics.staleness: A request outside the freshness window (or beyond the future skew) fails closed with STALE_REQUEST.
semantics.integrity: A payload that does not hash to the signed payloadHash fails closed with INTEGRITY_FAILED.
